name: Oboetate Kids
source: A young couple learn about the joys of sex. They live in a small apartment, which is very cramped, so they engage in sex in various public places: school, stairway of the apartment complex, train, public bath, telephone box...
translation: 一對年輕情侶瞭解性的樂趣。他們住在一間很窄的小公寓裡，所以他們在各種公共場所進行性行為：學校、公寓樓樓梯、火車、公共澡堂、電話亭……
